purpose: Adds paired light-on/light-off Flur artwork and labeled HTML hotspots in the interactive hall.

checks.lightToggle: Visible button switches paired images; aria-pressed and accessible action label track state. State survives SPA route changes during the current page session.
checks.navigation: Atelier to #karten; Teezimmer to #ort/P08; music to #musik; rooms to #raeume; gift link opens existing origin-story dialog.
checks.media: Room assets remain outside the app ZIP under /media/rooms/; application package remains top-level home/.

limitations: No iPhone Safari or VoiceOver visual test performed in this build.
Licht-aus artwork was supplied by the user and is treated as the paired room-state illustration.
